name: Don Colchón
description: Mexican mattress retailer with physical branches and an online store on Shopify. Its shipping page states free shipping to any state of Mexico for online purchases, direct delivery in cities with its own coverage, and carrier-branch pickup (ocurre) elsewhere.
description_es: Tienda de colchones mexicana con sucursales físicas y tienda en línea en Shopify. Su página de envíos indica envío gratis a cualquier estado de México en compras en línea, entrega directa en ciudades con cobertura propia y envío a sucursal de la paquetería (ocurre) en el resto.

ships_to.notes: Shipping page says online purchases include free shipping to any state of the country; direct delivery only in cities with own coverage, otherwise carrier-branch pickup (ocurre).

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Branch list exists; collecting an online order at a Don Colchón branch is not stated. Carrier-branch pickup (ocurre) is offered where there is no direct coverage.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Spanish-language Shopify store. Delivery time stated as 3 to 5 business days in Nuevo Leon and 3 to 10 in other cities with branches.

sources.supports: free shipping to all Mexico, direct delivery cities, ocurre pickup, delivery times
mattress retailer, branches page link, payment options
